follow_up_instruction: Lead follow-up 6 to GRM-D1 (2026-09-11): the queue launched --arm A --resume while the A1 contrast was leaving the card; the idle check refused and wrote run_A/cells/A-001-008 RED with GPU_NOT_IDLE, which then made --dry-lease fail with PRIOR_CELL_RED. Archive that cell create-only and re-arm arm A from cell 1; make GPU_NOT_IDLE a bounded wait-then-retry in the R1 await_idle shape (framebuffer used, counted loop, declines only, never signals), RED with a snapshot only after the bound; confirm the seam-restore audit failure was state-caused.

gate.evidence_class: CPU fixture over the idle policy (control flow and receipts; no GPU is probed)
fixtures: busy -> wait -> idle: the cell runs
busy past the bound: RED with the memory snapshot
probe failure: declines, with the reason
the wait is bounded and counted, never unbounded

idle_policy.after: bounded wait for the card to fall below a framebuffer limit, then proceed; RED with the memory snapshot ONLY after the bound expires
idle_policy.before: one nvidia-smi compute-app probe; any output -> ValueError GPU_NOT_IDLE -> the cell is RED and its reservation is charged
idle_policy.bound: structural: attempts_allowed caps the probe count up front, so there is no unbounded loop and nothing re-runs a cell
idle_policy.keys_on: TOTAL framebuffer used, never the compute-process list (FIX-8: never infer an idle card from an empty compute list)
idle_policy.never: signals, kills or waits on another process; it declines and it waits, nothing else
idle_policy.rationale: a busy card is a resource another process holds, not a fault in our cell

seam.name: await_idle
seam.what: run_cell consults an optional module global; the default branch is byte-identical to the two lines it replaced, so LT1 own campaign is unaffected

Seam with a byte-identical default: this campaign own pattern, established for spawn_argv in amendment 5
LT1.1 defaults and the receipt shape returned to run_cell: no prior art known to me

process_safety.gpu: the idle wait READS the card and declines; it never signals, kills or waits on another process. Only `--resume` without `--dry-lease` takes the shared lease, through LT1 own run_cell.
process_safety.operator: the operator has absolute right of way: a busy card makes this campaign wait, then stand down
